annotations.title: Report a gap in the catalog

description: FREE, no account — tell the catalog what you looked for and could not find. The consumer door (roadmap#166): a gap report is how the catalog learns what to add next, and a person reads the queue. One required field.

contact.description: Optional email if you want to hear when the catalog can answer this.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

found.description: What the search turned up: "nothing", "wrong thing" or "listed but unusable".

looked_for.description: What you were looking for, in your own words.

needed_for.description: Optional: the task you needed it for.

provider.description: Optional slug, when the gap is about an existing listing.

name: report_gap
